skulls.name: Trickle
skulls.description: Recharge of abilities is significantly reduced.

skulls.name: Grounded
skulls.description: Players take more damage while airborne.

skulls.name: Exposure
skulls.description: Guardian shields are increased but do not replenish.

skulls.name: Airborne
skulls.description: Players deal more damage while in the air.

skulls.name: Brawler
skulls.description: Guardian Melee damage is greatly increased.

skulls.name: Catapult
skulls.description: Grenade recharge rate is greatly increased.

skulls.name: Arc Burn
skulls.description: Arc Damage from any source is greatly increased.

skulls.name: Solar Burn
skulls.description: Solar Damage from any source is greatly increased.

skulls.name: Void Burn
skulls.description: Void Damage from any source is greatly increased.

skulls.name: Angry
skulls.description: Minions of the Darkness won't flinch, even after massive damage.

skulls.name: Juggler
skulls.description: No ammo drops for your equipped weapon.

skulls.name: Lightswitch
skulls.description: Minions of the Darkness deal much more melee damage.

skulls.name: Melee Damage Boost
skulls.description: Melee Damage from any source is greatly increased.
